cards.back: A tool that makes a job easier by changing the size or direction of a force.
cards.say: simple machine. A tool that makes a job easier by changing the size or direction of a force.

cards.back: The force you put in to move a load.
cards.say: effort. The force you put in to move a load.

cards.back: The weight or resistance that a machine moves.
cards.say: load. The weight or resistance that a machine moves.

cards.back: A bar that turns around a fixed point. It makes it easier to lift or move a load.
cards.say: lever. A bar that turns around a fixed point. It makes it easier to lift or move a load.

cards.back: The fixed point, also called the pivot, that a lever turns around.
cards.say: fulcrum. The fixed point, also called the pivot, that a lever turns around.

cards.back: A seesaw, a pair of scissors, a wheelbarrow, a crowbar or a bottle opener.
cards.say: Give three examples of levers. A seesaw, a pair of scissors, a wheelbarrow, a crowbar or a bottle opener.

cards.front: How can you make a lever easier to use?
cards.back: Push further from the fulcrum, so a small effort gives a bigger turning effect.
cards.say: How can you make a lever easier to use? Push further from the fulcrum, so a small effort gives a bigger turning effect.

cards.front: Where should you push on a door to open it with least effort?
cards.back: Far from the hinges. The hinges are the fulcrum.
cards.say: Where should you push on a door to open it with least effort? Far from the hinges. The hinges are the fulcrum.

cards.back: A wheel with a rope around it. It helps to lift loads.
cards.say: pulley. A wheel with a rope around it. It helps to lift loads.

cards.front: What does a single fixed pulley do?
cards.back: It changes the direction of the force, so you pull down to lift a load up.
cards.say: What does a single fixed pulley do? It changes the direction of the force, so you pull down to lift a load up.

cards.front: How does a pulley system with several wheels help?
cards.back: It reduces the effort needed, but you must pull more rope.
cards.say: How does a pulley system with several wheels help? It reduces the effort needed, but you must pull more rope.

cards.back: Cranes, flagpoles and lifts.
cards.say: Where are pulleys used? Cranes, flagpoles and lifts.

cards.back: A wheel with teeth that fits with another gear to pass on movement.
cards.say: gear. A wheel with teeth that fits with another gear to pass on movement.

cards.front: Which way does a gear turn compared with the gear it meshes with?
cards.back: The opposite way.
cards.say: Which way does a gear turn compared with the gear it meshes with? The opposite way.

cards.front: What happens when a small gear turns a bigger gear?
cards.back: The big gear turns more slowly, but with more turning force.
cards.say: What happens when a small gear turns a bigger gear? The big gear turns more slowly, but with more turning force.

cards.front: What happens when a big gear turns a small gear?
cards.back: The small gear turns faster, but with less turning force.
cards.say: What happens when a big gear turns a small gear? The small gear turns faster, but with less turning force.

cards.back: Gears help you pedal easily uphill or go fast on flat ground.
cards.say: Why do bicycles have gears? Gears help you pedal easily uphill or go fast on flat ground.

cards.back: A sloping surface, also called an inclined plane. It makes it easier to raise a load.
cards.say: ramp. A sloping surface, also called an inclined plane. It makes it easier to raise a load.

cards.front: How does a ramp make a job easier?
cards.back: You need less force, but you must move the load a longer distance.
cards.say: How does a ramp make a job easier? You need less force, but you must move the load a longer distance.

cards.front: Does a machine reduce the total work to be done?
cards.back: No. It reduces the force you need, but you move further.
cards.say: Does a machine reduce the total work to be done? No. It reduces the force you need, but you move further.

cards.back: A wheel fixed to a rod that turns. It makes it easier to move things.
cards.say: wheel and axle. A wheel fixed to a rod that turns. It makes it easier to move things.

cards.front: Which kind of machine is a see-saw?
cards.back: A lever. The fulcrum is in the middle.
cards.say: Which kind of machine is a see-saw? A lever. The fulcrum is in the middle.
